name: XMASS
summary: XMASS was a single-phase liquid-xenon rare-event experiment at Kamioka, Japan. Its main detector, XMASS-I, used high-light-yield scintillation to search for WIMPs, annual modulation and dark-matter absorption.
detection_principle: Many photomultiplier tubes surround the xenon target. Light yield, timing and spatial distributions reconstruct low-energy events and suppress surface backgrounds; no dual-phase-TPC-style S2 signal is measured.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
